changes.text: Habit reminders now have a time and the days of the week they apply to. Set them when you create or edit a habit.
The Whenever section of the task list starts collapsed.
Task link controls and notifications are easier to tap on touch screens.
A task's time log is hidden when no time has been logged.
Tasks closed in the evening showed the next day in the Completed list.
Habit progress could stay on the previous day after midnight until the page was reloaded.
Exporting to Loop Habit Tracker gave every habit a midnight reminder on no days. Habits without a reminder now export with none.
